name: Camp Schuylkill
operator_name: The Schuylkill Center for Environmental Education
description_short: Weekly nature day camp on the Schuylkill Center's 365 acres in Roxborough for ages 4 to 13, grouped by age. Campers hike, canoe and explore the forest, streams and ponds around a weekly theme; ages 10 and up add stewardship projects and a weekly field trip, and ages 12 to 13 camp overnight on four Thursdays.
refund_policy_summary: A 50% deposit holds a spot until April 19, 2027, and half of that deposit is refundable until then; after April 19 full payment is due and fees are non-refundable.
notes: 2027 weekly rates: ages 4 to 9 $500 (half day for ages 4 to 5 $375), ages 10 to 11 $550, ages 12 to 13 $610; the shortened July 5 week is $400, $440 or $488. Whole summer: $3,750, $4,125 or $4,575. One rate for everyone; members register first (from November 23, 2026), the public from January 4, 2027. 5% early bird through January 31, 5% sibling discount. Hours 9:00 to 3:30; before care 8:00 to 9:00 ($75 a week), aftercare 3:30 to 6:00 ($125 a week). Campers bring lunch. Accepts Child Care Works subsidy and the Youth Access $600 grant.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp Schuylkill 2027 page: weekly camp June 21 to August 13, 2027 for ages 4 to 13; rates by age group with no separate member rate (members only get early registration); before and aftercare; 'No food will be provided'; Child Care Works subsidy and Youth Access scholarship; refund terms. Address 8480 Hagy's Mill Road, Philadelphia PA 19128 from the page footer; phone is the camp contact line. Week names are the page's weekly themes. price_per_week is the standard ages 4 to 9 full day rate.
